'''''Bloomburrow''''' is a ''[[Magic: The Gathering]]'' expansion set released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on August 2, 2024. It is the 101st expansion<ref>{{cite web | last=Shannon | first=Abigail | title=Everything we know about MTG Bloomburrow | website=GamesRadar+ | date=June 26, 2024 | url=https://www.gamesradar.com/tabletop-gaming/everything-we-know-about-mtg-bloomburrow/ | access-date=October 10, 2025}}</ref> and the first set of the ''Dragonstorm'' story arc. The set takes place on the ''Bloomburrow'' plane in "Valley." It focuses on different factions of animalfolk and introduces several new mechanics such as forage, expend, and valiant, as well as revisiting threshold, each associated with a specific animalfolk faction. ''Bloomburrow'' featured guest artist [[David Petersen (comics)|David Peterson]], the creator of ''[[Mouse Guard]]''.<ref name="dsspoil" /> 

''Bloomburrow'' received very positive reception from players and critics. Due to high demand, the Commander pre-constructed decks from the set were reprinted and re-released on January 6, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Migalla |first=Sean |date=December 11, 2024 |title=Pricey Commander Precons Get Much-Needed Reprints |url=https://draftsim.com/expensive-edh-precons-reprinted/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Setting and story==
''Bloomburrow'' is set in Valley and is inhabited by anthropomorphic creatures known as animalfolk. Valley exists on the [[Multiverse (Magic: The Gathering)#Cosmology|plane]] of ''Bloomburrow'' and follows the story of the animalfolk uniting to stop the Calamity Beasts, elemental creatures whose sudden attacks threaten their way of life.<ref name="story">{{Cite web |title=A First Look at Bloomburrow |url=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/a-first-look-at-bloomburrow |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=MAGIC: THE GATHERING |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="story2">{{Cite web |last=Ignacio (Iñaki) |date=July 24, 2024 |title=Bloomburrow Lore & Story Summary |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-bloomburrow-story/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref> The Calamity Beasts are non-anthropomorphic animals<ref name= "story2" /> originating from ''Bloomburrow''. They are described as embodiments of natural disasters and control the plane's seasons, weather, and climate.<ref name="planeswalkerpt1">{{Cite web |last=LaPlante Johnson |first=Neale |title=Planeswalker's Guide to Bloomburrow, Part 1 |url=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/planeswalkers-guide-to-bloomburrow-part-1 |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=MAGIC: THE GATHERING |language=en-US}}</ref> 

In the [[#External links|official story]], the animalfolk of Valley are shown living together peacefully in villages before the Calamity Beasts start attacking. The first characters introduced are {{mtgcard|Helga, The Skittish Seer}}, a frogfolk living in Pondside, and {{mtgcard|Maha, Its Feathers Night}}, a Calamity Beast that leaves the dark night sky in its wake. In response to these attacks, the animalfolk of Valley work to defend their home<ref name="story3">{{Cite web |last=Fanany |first=David |date=November 27, 2024 |title=A Time for Everything: A Gameplay-Free Review of Bloomburrow |url=https://www.pojo.com/review-of-bloomburrow/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=Pojo.com |language=en-US}}</ref> and in the process encounter Ral Zarek, a planeswalker who appears in this plane as an otter named {{mtgcard|Ral, Crackling Wit}}, who joins their efforts against the Calamity Beasts.<ref name= "story2" /> Any non-animal visitors that come to ''Bloomburrow'' transform into an animal version of themselves typically retaining key identifying features.<ref name= "story2" /><ref name="cgmag">{{Cite web |last=De Hoog |first=Chris |date=July 10, 2024 |title=Okay, MTG's Next Set, Bloomburrow, Has Won Me Over |url=https://www.cgmagonline.com/articles/editorals/mtg-bloomburrow-won-me-over/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |language=en-CA}}</ref>

The main factions that comprise a majority of the story and cards correspond to Magic: The Gathering's two-color guild identities: birds in ''Azorius'' (White/Blue), rats in ''Dimir'' (Blue/Black), lizards in ''Rakdos'' (Black/Red), raccoons in ''Gruul'' (Red/Green), rabbits in ''Selesnya'' (White/Green), bats in ''Orzhov'' (White/Black), otters in ''Izzet'' (Blue/Red), squirrels in ''Golgari'' (Black/Green), mice in ''Boros'' (White/Red), and frogs in ''Simic'' (Blue/Green).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Forster |first=Danny |date=2024-07-20 |title=All MTG Bloomburrow Draft archetypes and signpost cards |url=https://dotesports.com/mtg/news/all-mtg-bloomburrow-draft-archetypes-and-signpost-cards |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Dot Esports |language=en-US}}</ref> Other animalfolk that appear in the set are badgers, hamsters, skunks, and weasels.

Some of the named major Calamity Beasts are Beza (elk),<ref name= "calamity" /> Eluge (fish),<ref>{{cite web | last=Ball | first=Nathan | title=New Bloomburrow Calamity Beast Literally Floods The Board With Counters | website=MTG Rocks | date=July 17, 2024 | url=https://mtgrocks.com/eluge-the-shoreless-sea-mtg/ | access-date=October 10, 2025}}</ref> Lumra (bear), Maha (owl),<ref name="calamity">{{cite web | last=Eichenseer | first=Jose Pedro | title=All MTG Bloomburrow Calamity Beasts, ranked | website=Dot Esports | date=July 21, 2024 | url=https://dotesports.com/mtg/news/all-mtg-bloomburrow-calamity-beasts-ranked | access-date=October 10, 2025}}</ref> Wildsear (wolf),<ref name= "planeswalkerpt1" /> and Ygra (cat),<ref>{{cite web | last=Smith | first=Bennie | title=Bloomburrow's Week 1 Previews For Commander MTG | website=Star City Games | date=July 12, 2024 | url=https://articles.starcitygames.com/magic-the-gathering/bloomburrows-week-1-previews-for-commander-mtg/ | access-date=October 10, 2025}}</ref> all of which are elemental creatures tied to the forces of nature. The story of ''Bloomburrow'' takes place in 4565 AR, a few years after the events of the ''Outlaws of Thunder Junction'' story.<ref name = "story2" />

==Development and design==
[[File:Bloomburrow_Play_Booster.png|thumb|right|The packaging for the ''Bloomburrow'' Play Booster pack featuring Mabel, Heir to Cragflame.]]
The set was first announced at [[Gen Con]] 2023 in Indianapolis, IN while hosting a panel for the 30th anniversary of Magic: The Gathering.<ref name="reveal">{{Cite web |last=Watson |first=Philip |date=August 5, 2023 |title=Magic: The Gathering 30th Anniversary Reveals 2024 Plans, Including Final Fantasy |url=https://www.cgmagonline.com/news/magic-the-gathering-2024-plans/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |language=en-CA}}</ref> ''Bloomburrow'' is the first set of the ''Dragonstorm'' story arc.<ref name = "storyline">{{cite web | last=Eichenseer | first=Jose Pedro | title=Biggest MTG storylines going into 2024 | website=Dot Esports | date=December 16, 2023 | url=https://dotesports.com/mtg/news/biggest-mtg-storylines-going-into-2024 | access-date=October 10, 2025}}</ref> It was designed by Doug Beyer and developed by Ian Duke. ''Bloomburrow'' also had a commander design team which was led by Annie Sardelis.<ref name="making2">{{Cite web |last=Rosewater |first=Mark |title=The Bloom of the Burrow, Part 2 |url=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/the-bloom-of-the-burrow-part-2 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250116130356/https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/the-bloom-of-the-burrow-part-2 |archive-date=2025-01-16 |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=MAGIC: THE GATHERING |language=en-US}}</ref> According to [[Mark Rosewater]], the team faced a challenge with the heavy typal{{efn|creature type focused}} set. Rosewater explained this issue further, "If only the Otter player wants the Otters, then the draft decks end up too similar to one another draft to draft and it lessens the long-term Limited playability of the set." To address this challenge, instead of including a large amount of "changeling"{{efn|a creature that has all creature types}} type creatures, the team instead introduced "duos", cards that represented two creatures from different factions working together{{emdash}}such as {{mtgcard|Bakersbane Duo}}.<ref name= "making2" />

==Mechanics and themes==
''Bloomburrow'' introduces the following new mechanics:
* Gift{{snds}}allows the player casting the spell to choose an opponent to receive a gift, if the gift is promised there will be an added effect to the spell that was cast. Six different types of gifts were introduced with ''Bloomburrow'': a card, an extra turn, an octopus, a tapped fish, a treasure, and a food.<ref name="mechs1">{{Cite web |last=Wischkaemper |first=Mark |date=2024-07-30 |title=Bloomburrow Mechanics: Gift |url=https://www.coolstuffinc.com/a/markwischkaemper-seo-07302024-bloomburrow-mechanics-gift |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=www.coolstuffinc.com |language=en}}</ref>
* Offspring{{snds}}a mechanic featured on creature spells that allows the player casting the spell to pay an additional cost. If the offspring cost is paid the creature will enter and create a 1/1 token copy of itself. If the offspring cost isn't paid the creature will enter normally and will not create a token copy of itself.<ref name= "mechs2">{{Cite web |last=Perry |first=Levi |date=2024-08-01 |title=The Mechanics of Bloomburrow: Offspring |url=https://www.coolstuffinc.com/a/leviperry-seo-08012024-the-mechanics-of-bloomburrow-offspring |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=www.coolstuffinc.com |language=en}}</ref>
* Forage{{snds}}the player has the choice to either exile three cards from their graveyard or sacrifice a food as an additional cost. Forage is primarily associated with the squirrel faction, it appears on six squirrel type creature spells and one instant spell,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Wischkaemper |first=Mark |date=August 9, 2024 |title=The Mechanics of Bloomburrow: Forage |url=https://www.coolstuffinc.com/a/markwischkaemper-seo-08092024-the-mechanics-of-bloomburrow-forage |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=www.coolstuffinc.com |language=en}}</ref> all of which are black, green, or ''Golgari''{{emdash}}both black and green.<ref name="mechs3">{{Cite web |date=July 19, 2024 |title=Bloomburrow (BLB) Limited Mechanics Review • MTG Arena Zone |url=https://mtgazone.com/bloomburrow-blb-limited-mechanics-review/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=MTG Arena Zone |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Expend{{snds}}a mechanic that tracks the total mana that a player spends on spells in a single turn. If the player spends the expend amount on spells in one turn, the expend effect or trigger occurs. Expend is exclusively found on red, green, or ''Gruul''{{emdash}}red and green{{emdash}}cards and primarily associated with the raccoon faction.<ref name="mechs4">{{Cite web |last=Hohns (Veveil) |first=Bryan |date=July 26, 2024 |title=The Ultimate Sealed Guide to Bloomburrow |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-blb-sealed-guide/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Valiant{{snds}}a triggered ability that causes an effect whenever a card is targeted for the first time each turn. Valiant is primarily associated with the mouse faction, it appears on nine mouse type creature spells, all of which are white, red, or ''Boros''{{emdash}}both white and red.<ref name="mechs5">{{Cite web |date=August 1, 2024 |title=The Magic of Mechanics - The Guilds of Bloomburrow |url=https://edhrec.com/articles/the-magic-of-mechanics-the-guilds-of-bloomburrow |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=EDHREC |language=en}}</ref>
* Seasons and Pawprints{{snds}}a modal mechanic that allows the player to spend five pawprints while casting the spell to create different effects. There are one, two, and three cost pawprint options.<ref name="dsspoil" />

It also modifies the rules term ''enter the battlefield'', and revisits the enchantment type ''class'', the ability ''threshold'', and the artifact type ''food''.<ref name= "mechs4" /> With the release of the ''Bloomburrow'' set, the rules term ''enter the battlefield'' was shortened to ''enter'' to allow for shorter and more concise card text.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Levine |first1=Eric |last2=Rabinowitz |first2=Eliana |title=Bloomburrow Release Notes |url=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/bloomburrow-release-notes |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=MAGIC: THE GATHERING |language=en-US}}</ref> Class, first introduced in ''[[Forgotten Realms]]'', is an enchantment type spell that is "leveled up" by paying a mana cost for each level and receiving the benefit of that level while the enchantment remains on the battlefield.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mlakar |first=A. |date=July 9, 2024 |title=MTG Class Cards - Rules and Interactions Explained |url=https://cardgamebase.com/mtg-class/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Card Game Base |language=en-US}}</ref> Threshold was originally introduced in ''[[Odyssey (Magic: The Gathering)|Odyssey]]'' and is primarily associated with the rat faction in ''Bloomburrow''.<ref name="dsspoil">{{Cite web |last=Zaccagnino |first=Timothy |date=August 21, 2024 |title=Bloomburrow Spoilers and Set Information |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-bloomburrow/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lai |first=Christopher |date=December 11, 2024 |title=Mechanics of Magic Overview: Threshold |url=https://www.coolstuffinc.com/a/christopherlai-seo-12112024-mechanics-of-magic-overview-threshold |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=www.coolstuffinc.com |language=en}}</ref> Food is a type of artifact token that was introduced in ''[[Throne of Eldraine]]'' and is revisited in ''Bloomburrow''. Food can be tapped and sacrificed for two colorless mana to gain three life.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kerghans |first=Herko |date=2023-08-21 |title=Throne of Eldraine Spoilers and Set Information |url=https://draftsim.com/throne-of-eldraine-mtg/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Card and product details==
The main set contains 281 cards, including 81 commons, 100 uncommons, 60 rares, 20 mythic rares, and 20 basic lands. It was released in a variety of product forms. Play boosters are randomized 14 card packs and include 1 Token, Ad, or Art card and at least one foil card.<ref name="product1">{{Cite web |last=Gravelle |first=Cody |date=July 24, 2024 |title=Magic: The Gathering Bloomburrow - Release Date, Preorders, New Cards, & Set Details |url=https://screenrant.com/mtg-bloomburrow-release-date-cards-preorder-sets/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=ScreenRant |language=en}}</ref> Value boosters are randomized 7 card packs (only available at select retailers) containing 3 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 wildcard (of any rarity), and one card that may be a land, a foil card, or a ''Special Guests'' card. The ''Bloomburrow'' Starter Kit which includes two preconstructed 60-card decks and two traditional foil legendary creature cards, as well as two codes to unlock both decks on [[MTG Arena]].<ref name="product3">{{Cite web |last=Lanham |first=Guy |date=July 15, 2024 |title=Quick Guide to Magic The Gathering: Bloomburrow |url=https://www.game.co.uk/blog/mtg-bloomburrow-guide |access-date=October 10, 2025 |website=GAME}}</ref> The ''Bloomburrow'' Bundle includes nine ''Bloomburrow'' Play Boosters, one foil alternate-art {{mtgcard|Thundertrap Trainer}}, 15 non-foil full-art basic lands, ten foil default-frame basic lands, five foil full-art basic lands, a spindown life counter, and a themed storage box.<ref name="product3"/>

[[File:Bloomburrow_Commander_set_icon.png|thumb|right|The ''Bloomburrow'' Commander set icon, a stylized flower in the shape of a shield. ''Courtesy Wizards of the Coast'']]
''Bloomburrow'' released four [[Magic: The Gathering Commander|Commander]] pre-constructed decks. The set code is BLC and the set icon is a styllized flower in the shape of a shield.<ref name="collecting" /> ''Squirreled Away'', a Golgari squirrel themed set with {{mtgcard|Hazel of the Rootbloom}} as the commander. ''Family Matters'', a Jeskai (White/Blue/Red) deck that focuses on the offspring mechanic and is commanded by {{mtgcard|Zinnia, Valley's Voice}}. ''Animated Army'', a Gruul deck that primarily uses enchantments as creatures with the commander {{mtgcard|Bello, Bard of the Brambles}}. ''Peace Offering'', which is Bant (Green/White/Blue) and is a "group hug"{{efn|A deck archetype that aims to provide resources such as mana, cards, creatures, health, and tokens to opponents. This deck type focuses heavily on "politics" where a player makes bargains and deals with opponents that impact the game.}} style deck featuring {{mtgcard|Ms. Bumbleflower}} as the commander.<ref name="DSJD">{{cite web |last1=Dunn |first1=Jeff |title=Peace Offering Upgrade Guide: 18 Easy Changes You Can Make |url=https://draftsim.com/peace-offering-upgrade-guide/ |publisher=DraftSim |access-date=5 November 2025 |date=11 October 2024 |ref=DSJD}}</ref>

In addition to the main set, ''Bloomburrow'' featured numerous treatments. 24 "Imagine: Courageous Critters" cards which are non-canon alternate art cards of planeswalkers and creatures in animalfolk forms.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kerghans |first=Herko |date=July 29, 2024 |title=Everything You Need to Know About Imagine: Courageous Critters Cards in Bloomburrow |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-imagine-courageous-critters/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref> 21 Japanese raised foil anime cards featuring alternate anime art and unique borders. Eight "field notes" alternate art cards (all of which are borderless) for the Calamity Beasts.<ref name= "collecting">{{Cite web |last1=Gordon |first1=Zakeel |last2=Rasmussen |first2=Blake |title=Collecting Bloomburrow: The Four Most Important Things to Know |url=https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/collecting-bloomburrow |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=MAGIC: THE GATHERING |language=en-US}}</ref> 20 full-art land cards, four of each land type{{emdash}}spring, summer, fall, and winter versions.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mlakar |first=A. |date=July 9, 2024 |title=Bloomburrow Basic Lands: Full List |url=https://cardgamebase.com/bloomburrow-basic-lands-full-list/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Card Game Base |language=en-US}}</ref> 42 "Showcase Woodland" border cards,<ref>{{Cite web |last=alexis |date=July 23, 2024 |title=Everything You Need to Know About the Showcase Woodland Cards in Bloomburrow |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-bloomburrow-showcase-woodland-cards/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref> 11 borderless cards, and 13 extended art cards complete the set.<ref name="collecting" />

Special Guest cards for ''Bloomburrow'' have the set code SPG and a set icon that is a star inside of a pentagon.<ref name="collecting" /> These cards can be found in ''Bloomburrow'' packs and include Frogmite, Kindred Charge, Ledger Shredder, Rat Colony, Relentless Rats, Secluded Courtyard, Sword of Fire and Ice, Swords to Plowshares, Sylvan Tutor, and Toski, Bearer of Secrets.<ref>{{Cite web |last=DotGG |date=July 18, 2024 |title=Bloomburrow Special Guests (SPG) • MTG Arena Zone |url=https://mtgazone.com/bloomburrow-special-guests-spg/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=MTG Arena Zone |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Gameplay and format legality==
{{As of|2025|07|25|df=mdy}} cards from ''Bloomburrow'' are legal in Standard,<ref name="standard">{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=S. C. G. |date=July 28, 2025 |title=MTG Standard Rotation Guide 2025 |url=https://articles.starcitygames.com/magic-the-gathering/mtg-standard-rotation-guide-2025/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Star City Games |language=en-US}}</ref> Pioneer,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Partlow |first=Emma |date=March 18, 2024 |title=Everything You Need to Know About MTG's Pioneer Format - Bans, Best Decks, and More! |url=https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Everything-You-Need-to-Know-About-MTG-s-Pioneer-Format-Bans-Best-Decks-and-More/4510800e-5bc6-4504-acfb-ffaff7eab5e1/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=TCGplayer |language=en}}</ref> Modern,<ref name="modern">{{Cite web |last=Quinn |first=Andrew |date=August 26, 2025 |title=The Ultimate Guide to Modern |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-modern/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref> Legacy,<ref name="legacy">{{Cite web |last=Quinn |first=Andrew |date=March 31, 2025 |title=The Ultimate Legacy Format Overview and Guide |url=https://draftsim.com/mtg-legacy/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Draftsim |language=en-US}}</ref> Vintage,<ref name="vintage">{{Cite web |last=Garcia |first=Johnny |date=March 20, 2023 |title=Magic: The Gathering – Every Card Banned In Vintage, And Why |url=https://www.thegamer.com/magic-the-gathering-mtg-vintage-every-card-banned-explained/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=TheGamer |language=en}}</ref> and Commander<ref name= "commander">{{Cite web |last=PlayingMTG |date=May 20, 2025 |title=Commander Banned Card List - Magic: The Gathering |url=https://playingmtg.com/commander-banned-card-list/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Playing MTG |language=en-US}}</ref> formats. Specific cards from the set can be banned or restricted in different formats. Legality is available on the official Gatherer website.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Magic: The Gathering Official MTG Card Search Database |url=https://gatherer.wizards.com/ |access-date=2025-10-10 |website=Magic: The Gathering Official MTG Card Search Database |language=en}}</ref>

==Reception==
''Bloomburrow'' was received positively by players and critics alike. Chase Carroll, a Commander content creator expressed that even though the set was not for them, that it is "one of Magic's greatest sets of all time."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Carroll |first=Chase |date=August 23, 2024 |title=Why I Don't Like Bloomburrow (And Why It's One Of The Best Magic Sets Of All Time) |url=https://articles.starcitygames.com/magic-the-gathering/why-i-dont-like-bloomburrow-and-why-its-one-of-the-best-magic-sets-of-all-time/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=Star City Games |language=en-US}}</ref> De Hoog of ''CG Magazine'' was initially skeptical of ''Bloomburrow'' but was won over by the story and the potential for the Commander format.<ref name= "cgmag" /> When Rosewater was asked whether ''Bloomburrow'' would be visited in another set on his tumblr blog, he ranked it amongst the most likely/soonest to revisit, making ''Bloomburrow'' a more popular plane than [[Theros]] or [[Throne of Eldraine|Eldraine]].<ref name= "story3" /><ref name= "return">{{Cite web |last=Miller |first=Nick |date=September 16, 2024 |title=MTG Head Designer "Very Optimistic" Of Return To Bloomburrow |url=https://articles.starcitygames.com/magic-the-gathering/mtg-head-designer-very-optimistic-of-return-to-bloomburrow/ |access-date=2025-10-09 |website=Star City Games |language=en-US}}</ref>

Bloomburrow is a Magic: The Gathering expansion set released by Wizards of the Coast on August 2, 2024. It is the 101st expansion and the first set of the Dragonstorm story arc. The set takes place on the Bloomburrow plane in "Valley." It focuses on different factions of animalfolk and introduces several new mechanics such as forage, expend, and valiant, as well as revisiting threshold, each associated with a specific animalfolk faction. Bloomburrow featured guest artist David Peterson, the creator of Mouse Guard. 
Bloomburrow received very positive reception from players and critics. Due to high demand, the Commander pre-constructed decks from the set were reprinted and re-released on January 6, 2025.
